agentInstruction: Keep a recognizable subject (project, technology or idea name) and a concrete use or scenario, preferably Subject: what it helps with. Ground the use in provided or verified note content. Avoid bare names, vague reference/explained labels, promotion and star counts. Do not describe candidate or planned capabilities as already implemented. If the purpose is unknown, keep a clearly marked draft and ask for the missing use; do not invent it. Respect an explicitly requested title. This is guidance, not a required punctuation format or automatic rewrite.
rules: 先保留可识别的项目、技术或想法名称，再说明具体用途或适用场景。
用途从已提供或已核实的正文提炼，避免只有项目名或泛泛的“参考／详解”。
不写推销语或涨星数字，不把候选能力、计划或设计建议写成已经实现。
资料不足时保留草稿并提示补用途；用户明确指定的标题优先。
这是命名引导；不强制冒号格式，不自动覆盖标题，也不调用付费模型。
